title: The effect of a free trade agreement with the United States on member countries’ per capita GDP: A synthetic control analysis
abstract: This study estimates the effects on member countries’ per-capita GDP of signing free-trade agreements with the United States. It applies the synthetic-control method to construct a counterfactual path for each country’s GDP in the absence of an agreement, allowing the difference from observed outcomes to be interpreted as an estimated causal effect. The results are heterogeneous: the estimates indicate positive effects for Chile and Jordan, while NAFTA is estimated to have harmed Mexico’s per-capita GDP.
